messages:
Marta (FinOps): Heads-up — we need a compact sample for an upcoming customer invoice audit. Can someone pull a 1-week sample of GPU-hours broken down by customer/project, plus notes on how reserved vs burst capacity was attributed? Need it by EOD tomorrow. cc @Kevin (Infra) @Sasha (ML Eng)
Kevin (Infra): I can run a BQ query against gpu_usage_metrics. Do we want allocation by 'billing_label' or split by actual container/job owner? The latter requires joining with k8s_job_labels which isn't populated for some ephemeral jobs.
Sasha (ML Eng): For inference clusters we stamp customer_id on the request path; but experimental notebooks are untagged. Suggest: 1) primary attribution by request.customer_id, 2) fallback to job labels, 3) mark untagged as "internal/experiment".
Marta (FinOps): That fallback logic sounds right. Please include counts of untagged GPU-hours and a quick confidence note (e.g., ~% of rows with fallback).
Kevin (Infra): SQL I plan to run (short sample):
```sql
SELECT customer_id, SUM(gpu_hours) AS gpu_hours, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_id) AS nodes
FROM `billing.gpu_usage_metrics` m
LEFT JOIN `infra.k8s_job_labels` j ON m.job_id = j.job_id
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY gpu_hours DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Kevin (Infra): I'll add a CASE to categorize reserved vs burst based on capacity_tag and billing_rate_code. Will attach the query + results to the thread once ready.
Ryan (Billing): Quick note — for invoices we must avoid charging reserved pool hours twice when customers get discounts via Dedicated. If you see entries where customer_id is NULL but capacity_tag='dedicated', flag them for manual review.
billing-bot: Automated alert — 14 untagged GPU instances detected in us-west-2 (daily sweep). Full list: https://internal.redwood/gpu-sweep/1840123456 :rotating_light:
Sasha (ML Eng): That's going to overlap with my experimental runs. I can run a small label backfill on notebooks that I own — will add customer tags for the past 7 days where possible.
Marta (FinOps): Thanks. Plan: Kevin run the query + attach CSV, Sasha do backfill for notebook tags, Ryan validate any potential double-billing flagged items. If we can get the CSV + notes by 4:30pm I can draft the audit summary.
Kevin (Infra): Running now; ETA ~45m. I’ll post raw CSV and a short readme describing join logic.
Sasha (ML Eng): Starting backfill now. FYI I found a single job owner that spanned multiple customer_ids — will mark it as 'shared-service' and include a recommended split proposal.
Ryan (Billing): If there's ambiguity, propose allocating shared-service proportionally by request_count. Approving that approach for this sample.
Marta (FinOps): Approved — proportional by request_count for the sample. TX.
Kevin (Infra): Uploaded results: https://internal.redwood/files/1840123456-gpu-sample.csv. Summary: 9% of GPU-hours untagged; 2 customers accounted for 63% of usage in the sample. See readme for reserved/burst rules.
Marta (FinOps): Perfect. Will draft the audit summary and circulate to customer-ops and the audit team. If anyone spots a red flag in the CSV ping me directly. :thumbsup:
